title: wg: ext-10 §4.6 app_components content unspecified
description: Suggestion. L585-587 a client "MUST understand and advertise the app_components component"; §5 (L913-916) defines it as the list of supported components but not whether it includes 0x0001 itself or every implemented component, which affects the check against the GroupContext required list. mimid lists only implemented components plus GREASE (decision mimid-1wgh.4.25). Fix: clarify.
notes: Editor's-copy check 2026-10-17: related open issues mlswg/mls-extensions#102 (enforcement) and #103 (update semantics); neither asks what app_components contains. Reference them.
